description: Create or update the root `.gitignore` plus a per-module `.gitignore` (`/build`) for each Gradle module of a Kotlin Multiplatform (Android + iOS) app — the layout `iru-setup-kmp-app` produces (`shared/`, `androidApp/`, `iosApp/`) or the JetBrains wizard's older single `composeApp/` module — covering Gradle/Kotlin noise (`.gradle/`, `build/`, the Kotlin 2.x root `.kotlin/` cache), `local.properties`, Android Studio/IntelliJ/Fleet files, APK/AAB outputs, keystores and Apple signing material (`*.jks`, `*.keystore`, `*.p8`, `*.p12`, `*.mobileprovision`, `*.cer`), `google-services.json`/`GoogleService-Info.plist`, Xcode output (`DerivedData/`, `*.xcresult`, `xcuserdata/`, `*.xcuserstate`), the XcodeGen-generated `iosApp/iosApp.xcodeproj/` (only when `iosApp/project.yml` exists — a hand-maintained `.xcodeproj` stays tracked), CocoaPods `Pods/` (only when a `Podfile` exists), Fastlane output (only when a `fastlane/` directory exists), the Antora docs build output, and the UI tests' screenshot directory `.ui-screenshots/` (never `.ui-quality.yml`, which is committed). Invoke as `/iru-setup-kmp-gitignore`, optionally with `args`: `mode: new|existing` (default: detected from whether a root `.gitignore` already exists), `modules: <comma/space-separated list>` (default: every `include(":…")` entry in `settings.gradle.kts`, falling back to whichever of `shared`/`androidApp`/`composeApp` exist), and `on-existing: ask|keep|update|replace` (default `ask`). Announces whether it is creating from scratch or updating existing files; if a root or per-module `.gitignore` already exists it never overwrites it silently — it warns, shows a diff, and asks per file whether to Update (merge in what's missing, keep hand-added lines), Keep as is, or Replace (regenerate from the template, dropping customizations), unless `on-existing` decides. Mirrors `iru-setup-android-gitignore` + `iru-setup-swift-gitignore` merged for the KMP stack. Use whenever a Kotlin Multiplatform app repository needs a `.gitignore` bootstrapped from scratch, or an existing one checked/gap-filled against this house template without touching it unless the user approves.
